about: The arguments Excel takes only as a Reference (ADR-0047; the seventeenth Windows run): Excel refuses SUBTOTAL(9,5), SUBTOTAL(9,SEQUENCE(3)), RANK.EQ(1,1) and AGGREGATE(14,6,A1:A11,1,2) on entry, and so does the engine. What can give a Reference is taken, and judged when it is computed. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' ReferenceArgumentTests.
